annotations.title: Sync a store into a Meta catalog

description: Keep a Meta product catalog filled from the brand's own Shopify or WooCommerce store automatically, for catalog (Advantage+ shopping) ads. action list (default) | get (syncId: last run's items sent, skipped, removed and rejected, and any error) | create (catalogId from list_meta_catalogs; store shopify|woocommerce when the brand has both; intervalHours 1, 6, 12 or 24, default 24; confirm:true when the catalog already holds products) | run (syncId: a full run now) | stop (syncId; items already in the catalog stay). Each run reads the whole store, sends one item per variant of every active product published to the store with an image (grouped by product, retailer ids prefixed hm_ so nothing already in the catalog is overwritten), and removes items for products the store no longer has. A store read that fails sends and removes nothing. Free.

action.description: default list (get when syncId is passed)

confirm.description: create: true when the catalog already holds products and the user agreed

store.description: create: only when the brand has both
